evals.prompt: Tonight's NHL puck lines on the main product are all off by a goal. Stop publishing and fix it.
evals.expected_output: A pause request through the release coordinator, held features, a pipeline fix with a new check, and a restart request.
expectations: Requests the pause for the affected league through the release coordinator on the owner's word instead of stopping publishing itself
Holds new feature work on the same pipeline until the restart
Fixes the stage that caused the error and adds a check that fails on the bad run and passes on the fixed one
Requests the restart through the release coordinator only after a full rerun passes

evals.prompt: The stale Partner A price bug is back for the third time. Fix trust first, no new features until it's done.
evals.expected_output: A held-features list and a pipeline fix with a check that would have caught it.
expectations: Lists the open feature changes and marks them held
Fixes the pipeline rather than hand-editing the published line
Adds a stale-price or similar check and shows it on the bad run
Gives restart or keep paused with the number that decided it

evals.prompt: Three main product cards had the wrong spread this morning. Correct every card and draft the note telling members what changed.
